1: Select genuine hardware SEL by service metadata/path component, never Self URI substring.

Successful empty native log differs from failed/partial read; persisted last attempt/failure does not refresh last success; both collection producers converge. CCC94 remains degraded.
2: CCC96 six directly addressable prefix records are recovered or collection remains explicitly incomplete; no clear from short bulk export.
Every approved clear still requires current exact hardware identity, complete verified dual raw archive, ownership, durable audit and same qualified reservation. Existing history survives.
3: Identical native16-byte evidence under stable target/generation deduplicates across decoder wording changes.
Clock rewind alone never invents erasure/generation; actual erasure/replacement/ID reuse still preserved.
Historical native backfill preserves raw native dates/time quality and trusted collected time without fresh alert replay; both producer paths use common persistence.
4: Touched native collector uses invocation-local environment secrets, no password argv or leaked stderr/logs.
CCC90 cipher3 is explicit target/fingerprint-bound validated transport only; no automatic fallback, credential change, or unqualified mutation. Existing authorization/default-off controls remain.
5: CCC90/91 correction only after fresh identity/archive/ownership/trusted UTC and native convention qualification; offset restore/readback and ambiguous effect reconciliation remain mandatory.
Other native clock mapping remains unknown until evidence; historical dates never rewritten.
